translation: Pallavi (Chorus): Leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village; leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village. All these years I grew up in your lap.. I roamed all over the fields and farmland; all these years I grew up in your lap.. I roamed all over the fields and farmland. Don't shed tears, mother.. we will come back again to the village that gave us birth. Leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village.

Verse 1: I sheltered my head in your cool lap.. sleeping on your breast, I dreamed so many dreams; I was enraptured by the songs of the birds.. I rejoiced to see how lovely you are. I sheltered my head in your cool lap.. sleeping on your breast, I dreamed so many dreams; I was enraptured by the songs of the birds.. I rejoiced to see how lovely you are. In the old well, my village.. and in the pond I swam, mother. Leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village.

Verse 2: When you drew on your veil of monsoon clouds.. when the drizzle set in and the village smiled softly; eating green gram pods and tart unripe guavas.. hearing the sweet calls of the golden peahen. When you drew on your veil of monsoon clouds.. when the drizzle set in and the village smiled softly; eating green gram pods and tart unripe guavas.. hearing the sweet calls of the golden peahen. My body thrilled with joy.. my heart listened in contentment. Leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village.

Verse 3: In your earthen embrace you shared your affection.. you gave me sweet memories I can never forget; whatever land I go to, wherever I may be.. my village that gave me birth, I will never forget you, mother. In your earthen embrace you shared your affection.. you gave me sweet memories I can never forget; whatever land I go to, wherever I may be.. my village that gave me birth, I will never forget you, mother. Mother, as I go leaving you behind.. my heart fills to the brim with sorrow. Leaving home, I am going away.. mother, leaving you, I take my leave, my village.
summaryEn:
Illidisi Yellipottunna ("Leaving Home, I Am Going Away") is a migration song, a farewell spoken by someone leaving their home village. The singer addresses the village itself as "thalli" (mother), a common way in Telangana songs of treating the village and its soil as a living, nurturing mother. The chorus is a leave-taking. The singer grew up in her lap and roamed her fields, and now asks her not to cry, promising that "we will come back again" to the village of their birth.

The verses are a string of fond childhood memories: sleeping in the village's "cool lap", birdsong, swimming in the old well and pond, monsoon clouds and steady drizzle, snacking on green gram pods and sour unripe guavas, and the call of the peahen. In the last verse the singer vows never to forget the village, whatever land they go to, and admits that their heart is full of sorrow at leaving. The song does not say why the singer must go, but its nostalgic, tender tone reflects the common experience of people leaving rural Telangana for work in cities or abroad. Each verse sings its lines twice and ends by returning to the chorus line of farewell.

ఇల్లిడిసి వెళ్ళిపోతున్నా అనేది వలస నేపథ్యంలోని పాట — పుట్టి పెరిగిన ఊరిని విడిచి వెళ్ళే వ్యక్తి చెప్పే వీడ్కోలు. పాడే వ్యక్తి పల్లెనే "తల్లి" అని సంబోధిస్తారు; ఊరిని, దాని మట్టిని ప్రాణమున్న, పెంచి పోషించే తల్లిగా భావించడం తెలంగాణ పాటల్లో తరచుగా కనిపిస్తుంది. పల్లవి ఒక వీడ్కోలు: ఇన్నాళ్ళు నీ ఒడిలో పెరిగాను, నీ చేను చెలకల వెంట తిరిగాను, ఇప్పుడు వెళ్తున్నాను; కన్నీరు పెట్టకు, కన్నవూరికి మళ్ళీ తిరిగి వస్తాం అని ఊరికి మాట ఇస్తారు.

చరణాలు చిన్ననాటి తీపి జ్ఞాపకాల వరుస — పల్లె చల్లని ఒడిలో నిద్ర, పక్షుల పాటలు, పాత నూతిలో, కుంటలో ఈతలు, వానాకాలం మబ్బులు, ముసురు, పెసరకాయలు, కసరు జామకాయలు తినడం, నెమలి తీపి కూతలు. చివరి చరణంలో ఏ దేశం వెళ్ళినా, ఎక్కడ ఉన్నా నిన్ను మరువనని ప్రమాణం చేస్తూ, నిన్ను విడిచి వెళ్తుంటే గుండె నిండా దుఃఖమే అని ఒప్పుకుంటారు. ఎందుకు వెళ్ళాల్సి వస్తోందో పాట చెప్పదు, కానీ దానిలోని మమకారం, బెంగ పని కోసం పట్నాలకో విదేశాలకో వెళ్ళే తెలంగాణ పల్లె ప్రజల సాధారణ అనుభవాన్ని ప్రతిబింబిస్తుంది. ప్రతి చరణంలోని పాదాలు రెండుసార్లు పాడబడి, చివరికి వీడ్కోలు పల్లవి పాదంతో ముగుస్తాయి.
